traits.label: Overview
traits.text: Parasitic fungus that infects and transforms the fruiting bodies of its host mushrooms, particularly those in the Russula and Lactarius genera. When infected, the host mushroom is entirely covered by a powdery layer of the mold that is distinctly yellow to greenish-yellow in color. This dramatic color change, combined with the altered texture, makes infected mushrooms easy to identify in the wild.
